calls.statement: SELECT week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30' ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at
SELECT max(week_ending_date) mx, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key, week_ending_date)) nd FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date, SUM(f.quantity) sold, count(*) lines FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE f.store_key=30 AND f.product_key=11 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) n, sum(closing_units) units, count(DISTINCT store_key) stores, max(etl_loaded_at) loaded FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-13' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
